card.name: The word infusion in preparation steps
card.fires_on: The word "infusion" (or its pieces, like Inf/US) in drug preparation and dilution instructions, especially after "intravenous", "the" or "prior to".

modes.label: Infusion bag or solution
modes.description: "infusion" after "the" or "an intravenous" when drug is added to a bag or solution.
modes.example: add it to the<< infusion>> bag containing 0.9% Sodium

modes.label: Prior to infusion
modes.description: "infusion" ending a phrase about diluting before giving the drug.
modes.example: Reconstitute and dilute MONJUVI prior to<< infusion>>.

modes.label: Split spellings
modes.description: Pieces of "infusion" or of Ringer's when the word is broken up or capitalised.
modes.example: AFTER MIXING WITH I.V. INF<<US>>ION FLUIDS, DO NOT RE
